question: Choose the odd one out.
solution:
Logic: all the numbers square of a number except 27.

(1) 4² = 16

**(2) 27 Not a square of any number. 27 is a cube of 3.**

(3) 8² = 64

(4) 9² = 81

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
